performance_case.causal_mechanism: Without pre-frozen output intent and post-result Manager acceptance, a weekly Local supplement would classify by mutable prose or broad task type, allowing infrastructure work, nested evidence or post-outcome judgment to inflate apparent research productivity and obscure the next falsifiable question.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This dispatch may design only one companion-only two-stage classification contract and a maximum four-file later offline slice from exact listed evidence. It cannot implement files, alter existing schemas or canonical reports, scan other results or history, refresh server state, add a timer or writer, create a strategy, register a hypothesis or candidate, open OOS, deploy or perform any Trading action.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Classification improves learning visibility only; neither output counts nor evidence-family counts prove predictive value, path-risk reduction or matched-capital drawdown improvement.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A bounded contract audit prevents building a misleading general report tool and keeps any later implementation to four offline files. It also preserves capacity for R2 by refusing CLI, server, canonical-report or scheduler integration unless explicit classification authority can be closed cheaply.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The contract cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL directly. Its research value is preventing duplicate, infrastructure and post-outcome classifications from masquerading as useful strategy learning, so Coach attention and future Local capacity remain allocated to genuinely falsifiable evidence and accepted capabilities.
